heroTitle: Plant smarter with 20 years of climate data
heroText: Explore climate information and plan agricultural activities with data-driven insights designed for Bangladesh.
problemTitle: Weather is hard to plan around
problemText: Rainfall timing, heat and dry spells decide how a season goes. Bonayon puts long-term climate history next to your soil and season, so planning starts from data instead of guesswork.
cropText: See which crops fit your district, soil and season, with the reasons behind each score.
planText: Get a planting window and plain-language advice for each of your plots.
riskText: Know which months have heatwave and dry-spell risk, based on past climate.
